contentText:
The Meta Quest 3S is an excellent entry-level headset that’s currently $250. | Image: The Verge

Meta’s VR strategy is in a bit of an uncertain place right now, with the company recently cutting many jobs at its Reality Labs, and discontinuing new content drops in beloved experiences like Supernatural . Even so, there’s still a lot of fun to be had with its Meta Quest 3S if you’ve been curious about jumping in. It’s a great entry-level headset, and the 128GB model is available at Walmart with a free copy of Batman: Arkham Shadow for $249 ($50 off), which matches its Black Friday price. Currently, no other retailers are offering this sale price.

Meta Quest 3S

Where to Buy:

- $299.99 $249.99 at Walmart (128GB, with Batman: Arkham Shadow)

The Quest 3S can play the same games as the pricier Meta Quest 3 , with Batman: Arkham Shadow and Maestro performing impressively well in our testing. Additionally, you can stream Xbox games with a Game Pass subscription and even wirelessly tether it to a gaming PC to play SteamVR games like Half-Life: Alyx . The Quest 3S is powered by the same Qualcomm Snapdragon XR2 Gen 2 processor that’s in the pricier Quest 3, although its display resolution and optics quality are on-par with the Quest 22. It features full-color passthrough, allowing you to see your surroundings without removing the headset. And, to top it off, it comes with the Quest 3’s Touch Plus controllers.

Read our Meta Quest 3S review .

More ways to save

- You can pick up a physical copy of Little Nightmares III for $23.94 — a new low price at $16 off — for the Nintendo Switch at Amazon (you can also grab the Xbox Series X version at Woot for $19.99). For the first time in the atmospheric horror puzzle-platformer series, the 2025 sequel introduces two protagonists, both trying to escape a terrifying new location called the Spiral. The game also adds online co-op, allowing two people to play together, or an AI-controlled companion will join you in its single-player mode.

- The Nothing Headphone 1 over-ear headphones are on sale for $239 ($60 off) at Amazon and directly from Nothing , matching their best price. The company’s eye-catching, transparent design doesn’t skimp on features. They have  solid active noise cancellation, a unique paddle-style button for controlling music, and plush earpads that make them even more comfortable to wear than one of our favorite pairs of noise-canceling headphones, the Sony WH-1000XM6 . Read our review .

- The official Apple Crossbody Strap is on sale starting at $26.98 ($33 off) for the tan color at Amazon , which is a new low price. Other colors are discounted, including the black strap that’s cheaper than ever at $35.17 ($24 off) . These straps are made from recycled PET yarns, and are designed to keep your phone secure and easily accessible. The length is adjustable, and it attaches easily to the latest iPhone cases, including the iPhone Air bumper case, iPhone 17 silicone case, and iPhone 17 Pro and Pro Max silicone and TechWoven cases .
